# Fetch42

> The data layer for AI agents: real-time public web & social data (TikTok, Instagram,
> YouTube, X, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Google search/news/maps/shopping/images,
> Hacker News, Wikipedia, weather) through one API key and one prepaid USD balance,
> priced per call. Normalized JSON, automatic failover, cost on every response,
> failed calls never charged, no subscriptions.

- [Agent setup skill](https://fetch42.ai/SKILL.md): paste-ready instructions for an agent to integrate Fetch42
- [API reference](https://fetch42.ai/docs/): core endpoints, params, prices
- [Live catalog](https://api.fetch42.ai/v1/catalog): machine-readable list of all 252 live endpoints
- [Dashboard](https://fetch42.ai/dashboard/): create an API key ($1 free credit, no card)
- Base URL: https://api.fetch42.ai — auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://api.fetch42.ai/mcp — all 252 endpoints as MCP tools, same key/prices, cost in every result (fallback while the cert provisions: https://gateway-production-2c1d.up.railway.app/mcp)
- Contact: laurent@fetch42.ai
